thought: The most immediate enabled recovery step is to clear the explicit open guard that requires xarm6@localhost to reach idle. From the authoritative DES state, xarm6@localhost is currently in resource_state=failed with no held part, so a recovery/reset transition to idle is grounded and directly progresses the session. In parallel, SAFE_1 prevents MCP placement at the assembly station until LG has been placed there first, so any immediate MCP-to-assembly action is not acceptable. ur5e@localhost is currently holding MCP, so a non-assembly relocation such as moving to home remains plausible as a staging action, but it does not satisfy the open guard as directly as recovering xarm6. I therefore select the xarm6 recovery transition first.
